name: strut
description: Open-source, AI-native motion design studio for interactive product graphics.

scripts.check: npm run check:ts && npm run check:runtime && cargo check --workspace
scripts.check:ts: npm --workspace @strut/studio run check && npm --workspace @strut/site run check
scripts.check:runtime: npm --workspace @strut/runtime-web run check && npm --workspace @strut/react run check && npm --workspace @strut/next run check
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm run test && npm run test:ui && npm run test:site && npm run test:runtime-ui && npm run test:mascot-puzzle
scripts.runtime:build: npm --workspace @strut/runtime-web run build && npm --workspace @strut/react run build && npm --workspace @strut/next run build
